name: Daemonforge
community_notes: [APPROX] On a Dark Pact this unit re-rolls Wound rolls of 1; the second step models the once-per-battle overcharge that instead grants a full Wound re-roll. The overcharge is optional and, if the Dark Pact Leadership test is then failed, the model suffers 3 mortal wounds instead of D3 — not modeled here. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Chirurgeon
community_notes: [APPROX] applies to this unit's Fabius Bile model; if he was attached when destroyed, he is set back up attached to that unit

name: Tyrannical Motivation
community_notes: [APPROX] Each Command phase, HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY units gain one selected ability — Huron's Elite (+1 to Hit rolls) or Mobile Marauders (eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn it Fell Back), modeled as a re-selectable menu. The clause granting BOTH abilities to units visible to Huron Blackheart is not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Debt to the Soul Forge
community_notes: [APPROX] When a HERETIC ASTARTES DAEMON VEHICLE unit invokes its contract on a Dark Pact: −1 to the resulting Leadership test, +1 to ranged Wound rolls, and +2 Attacks to melee weapons. The DAEMON VEHICLE restriction and the optional invoke are noted rather than gated in the tree. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Slaves to None
community_notes: [APPROX] Models the two static clauses: HERETIC ASTARTES models lose the Dark Pacts ability and their ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT]. Not modeled: the mustering restriction (cannot use Cults of the Dark Gods), the Vendetta target (re-roll Hit rolls against a chosen enemy unit by non-DAMNED models), and Twisted Doctrine (Default to Doctrine, taking a Battle-shock test to gain shoot/charge-after-Fall-Back or charge-after-Advance). Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Terror Descends (Aura)
community_notes: [APPROX] A 12" battle-shock-test debuff aura: forces the test and applies −1 to the result. The rule forces the test specifically on enemy units below their Starting Strength and applies the −1 to any enemy unit within 12" (the encoding ties the −1 to below-half via `bonus_if_below_half`); its 'no other Battle-shock tests this phase' clause is not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Desperate Devotion
community_notes: [APPROX] Models the Desperate Pact bonus for DAMNED units with Dark Pacts: +2" Move and +2 to Charge rolls. Not modeled: the optional activation, the exclusion of units that arrived from Reserves this turn, and the Leadership test taken to make a Desperate Pact (D3 mortal wounds on failure). Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Focus of Hatred
community_notes: [APPROX] Each Command phase, mark one enemy unit as the focus of hatred; HERETIC ASTARTES models re-roll Hit rolls against it. The rule excludes DAMNED models from the re-roll — an exclusion not modeled here. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Terror Made Manifest
community_notes: [APPROX] Models the 12" battle-shock-test debuff (force + −1) and +1 to Hit rolls against targets Below Half-strength. Not modeled (the DSL has no Battle-shocked-state condition): −1 to Hit for Battle-shocked attackers targeting HERETIC ASTARTES, and +1 to Wound against Battle-shocked targets; nor the 'no other Battle-shock tests this phase' clause. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Experimental Augmentations
community_notes: [APPROX] Models the six augmentation options as a battle-long selectable menu for HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY. Not modeled: the pick-one-or-roll-two-D6 selection method, the DAMNED exclusion, the duplicate-has-no-effect clause, and Fabius Bile's re-roll of the augmentation dice. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Architect of Ruin
community_notes: [APPROX] Selects a hated foe at the start of the battle; models the re-roll to Wound rolls against it via the marked-target mechanism. Because that mechanism buffs all attacks against the mark, the restriction to this model's own attacks is not enforced, and the clause allowing a new hated foe to be chosen when the current one is destroyed is not modeled. Full rule in raw-text store.
